The '''f-9 Heavy Ion Cannon''' was a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannon]] made by [[CoMar Combat Systems/Legends|CoMar Combat Systems]]. It cost 3,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]],<ref name="GG6-2" /> weighed between one<ref name="PP" /> and two [[Metric ton/Legends|metric tons]],<ref name="GG6-2" /> and had an [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmospheric]] range of three-point-six [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]]. The weapon was no more powerful than CoMar's [[f-4 Medium Ion Cannon]] but did have a superior [[Targeting computer/Legends|fire control computer]].<ref name="PP" />
